difficulty_scale.meaning: 1 = easy to sneak into a professional meeting; 5 = almost unsayable without giving the agency away

agencies.notes: The reference case from the spec. Kohlrabi is unmistakably a vegetable so the room has a route.

agencies.change_log: Removed opening, exchange, endgame. All three are business-native. Replaced with chess-only pieces and moves.
agencies.notes: First three are native business metaphors. En passant is fully diagnostic.
Thread and seam are common in software and process talk which makes the ramp steep.

agencies.change_log: Kept as Card Games. Added poker terms (full house, five card draw) and removed deal, shuffle, bluff as too common.
agencies.notes: Cribbage and solitaire carry the category. No gambling framing since the card is not poker-only.
Orbit and eclipse are common. Constellation of is a consulting cliche which helps.
All five are lunch talk. Easy end is not truly easy.
Pepper is the only genuinely low-friction word.
Apple and cherry pick both have work uses. Lychee is the tell.
Shepherd plants easily. Pet talk gives the rest a natural home in a distributed team.
Salmon and tuna are lunch words. Monkfish is diagnostic.
Level and wrench are metaphor-ready. Plumb line is a strong tell.
It takes two to tango is a business cliche which does real camouflage work.

agencies.change_log: Removed mast as instructed and added sextant. Also dropped anchor, which is a business metaphor.
agencies.notes: Anchor is an anchoring metaphor. Spinnaker is unmistakable.
Amazon is nearly free to say. The rest need construction which is the point.
Vacation talk is the natural cover. Weak easy end.

agencies.change_log: Ulaanbaatar replaced with Reykjavik. Same category signal, plantable in travel talk.
agencies.notes: Travel talk cover. Ulaanbaatar is one of the hardest single words in the library.
Diamond and pearl have idioms attached. Tourmaline is diagnostic.
Common enough to be low-risk. Low ceiling of interest.
Mint condition and thyme homophone give two easy routes.
Beverage talk cover. Overlaps with the coffee agency conceptually.
Clay is the only easy word. Hard end may be too hard.
Pyramid is free. Steep jump after that.
Moat is a standard strategy term. Portcullis is unmistakable.
Hive mind and swarm are agile vocabulary. Apiary is the tell.
Fossil and extinct are business words. Very steep jump to the hard end.

agencies.change_log: Removed force and droid. No genuinely easy word survives. Floor is 2.
agencies.notes: Force multiplier and may the force are already business speech. Broadest recognition of any property here.
Spell out is free. Wide but not universal recognition.

agencies.change_log: Removed precious as instructed. Also removed ring and fellowship, both of which have ordinary work meanings.
agencies.notes: Ring and precious plant easily. One does not simply is a known meme which helps guessers.

agencies.change_log: Removed conference room and branch manager.
agencies.notes: First two are literal office vocabulary which is an excellent trap.
Yellow brick road and no place like home are common idioms. Very broad recognition.

Fairy godmother is a usable metaphor. Flat difficulty curve.
Difficult across the board. Recognition is high but planting is hard.

agencies.change_log: Removed beach and chum. Bigger boat retained since it is the guessing route.
agencies.notes: Gonna need a bigger boat is a business cliche which does the guessing work.
Get out of jail free is ordinary speech. Universal recognition.
Broad multigenerational recognition. Snuffleupagus is the tell.

agencies.change_log: Blockhead replaced with Linus.
agencies.notes: Good grief and security blanket are ordinary speech. Excellent camouflage.

agencies.change_log: Removed elementary and deduction.
agencies.notes: Elementary and deduction are fully business-native. Deerstalker is diagnostic.
